summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that about 800 people saw Tom Allen spar Joe Coburn at Coburn's benefit at Mozart Hall, and that a benefit for Allen was set for Saturday night, when his belt would be presented.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Missouri Republican, Tuesday April 26, 1870.

facts.fact: Allen sparred Joe Coburn at a benefit for Coburn at Mozart Hall, St. Louis, before about 800 people
A benefit for Allen was announced for Saturday night, when his championship belt would be presented

notes: Fact 021 dates the belt presentation April 29, 1870; this article (Saturday) and 397 point to Saturday April 30.
